privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.footerNote: By using the HeartNote website, you agree to the Terms of Use and this Privacy Policy.

paragraphs: 1. This policy forms an integral part of the agreement between the visitor and Nitzan Ben-Porat and Ilay Admoni (the "Site Operators"), which consists of the Terms of Use and this Privacy Policy. Terms used in this Privacy Policy carry the meaning given to them in the Terms of Use, unless expressly stated otherwise below.

2. By using the site, the visitor consents to the Site Operators (or those acting on their behalf) holding the details they provided, along with any data derived from analyzing those details and any information about them that has reached or will reach the Site Operators as a result of using the site. That information may be used, among other things, for the following purposes:
*To let visitors use the various services and content offered on the site;
*To improve and expand the services and content offered on the site;
*To change or discontinue existing services and content;
*To personalize the content shown to the visitor while using the site;
*For internal purposes, such as research and investigating complaints or reviews.
*For security purposes and fault monitoring.
*To contact the visitor using the contact details they left.

*To contact the visitor and send updates, marketing material, newsletters and promotional offers (subject to the visitor's consent as required by law). Visitors may opt out of receiving marketing material at any time ("unsubscribe").
3. The visitor confirms they understand they are under no legal obligation to provide information, and that any information provided is given freely and with their consent.

4. The Site Operators will retain information for no longer than necessary and intend to store it properly and securely in accordance with applicable law. The visitor agrees and acknowledges that information may be stored in databases and cloud servers located outside the State of Israel (including in the United States and Europe), and that such storage will follow market-standard practices and applicable law.

5. Visitors may at any time ask the Site Operators to review, delete or correct information they provided, by writing to heartnote.web@gmail.com. The Site Operators will act on such requests within a reasonable time.

6. The Site Operators may collect and/or derive data about the visitor and their use of the site in one or more of the following ways: (a) information the visitor provides when leaving contact details - first and last name, date of birth, phone number, email address; (b) data the Site Operators may collect based on how the visitor uses the site; (c) statistical data that does not personally identify the visitor, as detailed below. It is clarified that personal content the visitor enters into the site as part of using HeartNote's services ("Personal Content") is stored in the system for that visitor's own use only. The Site Operators will not make commercial use of Personal Content, will not sell it to third parties, and will not use it for any other purpose, except to provide the technical service, back up the data, or if required to do so by court order.

7. When a visitor accesses the site, the Site Operators collect the internet protocol (IP) address of the device the visitor uses to browse the site. The Site Operators also use third-party analytics tools, such as Google Analytics, to automatically collect aggregate information about how visitors use the site.

8. The Site Operators and their business partners may use various technologies to collect and store statistical data while the visitor browses the site, including cookies or similar technologies, for the ongoing and proper operation of the site, including gathering usage statistics, validating data, personalizing the site to the visitor's preferences, and information-security purposes. Modern browsers let you decline cookies; if you're not sure how, check your browser's help file for instructions.

9. The Site Operators implement up-to-date information-security systems and procedures in accordance with the law. While these systems and procedures reduce the risk of unauthorized access, they do not provide absolute security, and the Site Operators do not guarantee the site will be fully immune to unauthorized access to the information it stores. The visitor hereby waives any claim, demand or lawsuit against the Site Operators, or anyone acting on their behalf, for any damage, loss or harm of any kind arising from a leak of the visitor's personal information due to such unauthorized access.

10. The Site Operators will avoid transferring personal information, or any other information about a visitor, to a third party without the visitor's express consent, to the extent such information was received without that consent. Notwithstanding the above, in any of the cases below the Site Operators may, but are not required to, transfer the information in whole or in part, as the circumstances warrant, even without the visitor's express consent:
*A breach of this Privacy Policy and/or the agreement and/or any law.
*Legal provisions that require the Site Operators to transfer the information, in whole or in part, to any third party.
*In the event of any dispute, or any legal or quasi-legal proceeding, between the visitor and the Site Operators.

*Where the Site Operators believe, at their sole discretion, that transferring the information could prevent serious harm to the visitor, their life, health or property, or serious harm to any third party.
*Where the activity connected to the site is transferred to another party, the Site Operators may provide that party with all the information in their possession so it can operate the site.

*It is clarified that to process payments on the site, the Site Operators rely on secure external payment-processing services from recognized providers (such as SUMIT). Credit card details are never stored on the site's servers or in the Site Operators' databases; they are transmitted directly to the external provider's payment systems for billing purposes only. Processing takes place under the strict PCI-DSS security standard and in accordance with credit card company requirements.

11. It is clarified that the exceptions above regarding data retention do not impose any obligation on the Site Operators to report or transfer information to anyone, and the visitor, or anyone acting on their behalf, will have no claim, demand or lawsuit against the Site Operators regarding the transfer or non-transfer of information, or the consequences of either.

12. Use of the site is intended for adults over the age of 18. If the visitor is a minor under that age, use of the site is conditional on a guardian's consent. The Site Operators do not knowingly collect personal information from minors without parental consent. If the Site Operators become aware that information was collected from a minor without consent, it will be deleted promptly.

13. Dear visitor, various activities and services on the site may carry additional terms regarding your privacy. Unless expressly stated otherwise in writing, any such additional terms will apply alongside those included in this policy.
14. Any question relating to this Privacy Policy can be directed to the Site Operators at heartnote.web@gmail.com
E&OE.

5.title: 9. Payments, Subscriptions and Cancellation Policy

d. Cancellation of a transaction and refunds will be handled in accordance with the Consumer Protection Law, 5741-1981, and its regulations.

*Please note: for digital products or services available for immediate use (such as access to premium content), a right of cancellation may not apply once access to the service has been granted, in line with the law's exceptions for "information as defined under the Computers Law".

accessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibilityStatement.footerNote: By using the HeartNote website, you agree to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

paragraphs: We place great importance on making the site accessible and usable for all visitors, including people with disabilities.
We invest significant resources to ensure an accessible, comfortable and equal browsing experience.

2.title: Compliance with accessibility standards
paragraphs: This site was built and adapted in accordance with the Israeli Standard IS 5568 and the international WCAG 2.1 Level AA standard.

3.title: Key accommodations on the site
paragraphs: Use of technologies that support screen-reading software.
The ability to navigate the site using a keyboard alone.
High-contrast colors, with the option to adjust colors and enlarge text.
Clear, visible focus indicators for page elements.
Alt text for images and graphic elements.

4.title: Clarifications and exceptions
paragraphs: Despite the significant effort and resources we invest, some parts of the site may not yet be fully accessible, as a result of third-party solutions integrated into the site (such as external widgets). We will keep working to improve accessibility and remove existing barriers.

5.title: Feedback and accessibility inquiries
paragraphs: We welcome comments and suggestions for improving the site's accessibility.
To reach us about an accessibility issue, please email heartnote.web@gmail.com
